$case.name: 06 Valid FULL_REBALANCE (exercises if/then)
$case.note: FundTransferRequest carries an allOf[if/then] that adds rules when amountType is FULL_REBALANCE. Note that the if/then adds CONSTRAINTS, not new properties, so neither keyword changes the outcome here. Contrast with a spec where if/then introduces conditional properties - there, additionalProperties:false would reject them and unevaluatedProperties:false would not.
